_readme: Researched dates for the reseller calendar at /tools/calendar.

Every entry needs an official source (the brand's own site or press release, https only) and the date it was checked (YYYY-MM-DD). Never add a date from a rumour, a leak, a retailer listing or a third-party prediction.

Fields: id (unique, kebab-case, never reuse or change it because calendar apps use it), date (YYYY-MM-DD, UK on-sale or start date), endDate (optional, last day), title, category (pokemon, lego, sale or other), region (UK), source (https URL), checked (YYYY-MM-DD), note (optional).

LEGO does not publish retirement dates. Its 'Retiring soon' page (https://www.lego.com/en-gb/categories/last-chance-to-buy) lists sets without dates, so retirements only go in here if LEGO itself names an end-of-sale date.
Fee and policy changes come from content/changes, tax dates from src/lib/tools/tax.ts, and bank holidays from the GOV.UK feed, so do not repeat them here.
The daily change monitor or staff can add entries. Remove nothing that has passed; the page hides old entries on its own.
